models.model_label: KS discretionary-accrual construction regression (GMM by year and two-digit SIC)
models.sample_description: Compustat financial data for accrual estimation during 1988–2001; fitted separately by year and two-digit-SIC category with at least 10 observations per cell. Exact cell Ns are not reported.
models.method_details: The construction fit is GMM; dependent and independent variables from the preceding two years are used as instruments.

dependent_variable.name: ACCL_t / TA_(t−1)
dependent_variable.definition: Current-year total accruals calculated from the statement of cash flows and scaled by beginning-of-year total assets; ACCL is net income less operating cash flow and TA is total assets.

evidence.quote: The displayed KS equation is ACCL_t/TA_(t-1) = c0 + c1*(REV_t/TA_(t-1))*(ART_(t-1)/REV_(t-1)) + c2*(EXP_t/TA_(t-1))*(OCAL_(t-1)/EXP_(t-1)) + c3*(GPPE_t/TA_(t-1))*(DEP_(t-1)/GPPE_(t-1)) + epsilon_t.
ACCL = Net Income (#172)-Operating Cash flow (#308)
TA = Total assets (#6)
Our total accruals are calculated from statement of cash flow.

independent_variables.name: (REV_t / TA_(t−1)) × (ART_(t−1) / REV_(t−1))
independent_variables.definition: Current-year revenue divided by prior-year total assets, multiplied by prior-year accounts receivable less tax receivables divided by prior-year revenue. REV is revenues; ART is accounts receivable less tax receivables.

evidence.quote: The displayed KS equation is ACCL_t/TA_(t-1) = c0 + c1*(REV_t/TA_(t-1))*(ART_(t-1)/REV_(t-1)) + c2*(EXP_t/TA_(t-1))*(OCAL_(t-1)/EXP_(t-1)) + c3*(GPPE_t/TA_(t-1))*(DEP_(t-1)/GPPE_(t-1)) + epsilon_t.
REV = Revenues (#12)
ART = Accounts receivable (#2) less Tax receivables (#161)
TA = Total assets (#6)

independent_variables.name: (EXP_t / TA_(t−1)) × (OCAL_(t−1) / EXP_(t−1))
independent_variables.definition: Current-year expenses divided by prior-year total assets, multiplied by prior-year other current assets and liabilities divided by prior-year expenses. EXP is revenues less operating income before depreciation. OCAL equals current assets less ART, cash, income-tax refunds, and current liabilities net of income taxes payable.

evidence.quote: The displayed KS equation is ACCL_t/TA_(t-1) = c0 + c1*(REV_t/TA_(t-1))*(ART_(t-1)/REV_(t-1)) + c2*(EXP_t/TA_(t-1))*(OCAL_(t-1)/EXP_(t-1)) + c3*(GPPE_t/TA_(t-1))*(DEP_(t-1)/GPPE_(t-1)) + epsilon_t.
EXP = expenses = Revenue (#12)- Operating income before depreciation (#13)
OCAL = other current assets and liabilities = Current assets (#4)-ART-Cash (#1)- Income tax refund (#161)-(Current liabilities (#5)- Income taxes payable (#71)
TA = Total assets (#6)

independent_variables.name: (GPPE_t / TA_(t−1)) × (DEP_(t−1) / GPPE_(t−1))
independent_variables.definition: Current-year gross plant, property and equipment divided by prior-year total assets, multiplied by prior-year income-statement depreciation divided by prior-year gross plant, property and equipment. GPPE is gross plant, property and equipment; DEP is depreciation from the income statement.

evidence.quote: The displayed KS equation is ACCL_t/TA_(t-1) = c0 + c1*(REV_t/TA_(t-1))*(ART_(t-1)/REV_(t-1)) + c2*(EXP_t/TA_(t-1))*(OCAL_(t-1)/EXP_(t-1)) + c3*(GPPE_t/TA_(t-1))*(DEP_(t-1)/GPPE_(t-1)) + epsilon_t.
GPPE = gross plant, property and equipment (#7)
DEP = Depreciation from Income Statement (#14)
TA = Total assets (#6)
